about_the_game:
ROBOROBI is a slightly more challenging side-scrolling 2D action platformer.

Roborobi

Roborobi's wheel control system is busted, so he can’t stop moving. He just keeps going forward! Take command of our little buddy and guide him across intricate and dangerous platforms.

Unlock New Moves

Roborobi is a high spec robot: pick up cassettes to install new abilities. He starts with nothing, but soon learns to jump, speed up, slow down, and much more.

Plenty of Stages

This game is structured stage by stage. Clear them one after another—and aim to beat them all to finish the game.

Collect Gears

Reaching the goal isn’t your only objective. Collect the gears scattered throughout each stage to unlock the next one.

Thoughtful Level Design

ROBOROBI is designed so everyone—from newcomers to platforming veterans—can have fun. Each stage offers a well‑balanced challenge and a satisfying sense of accomplishment.
